facts.fact: ITEdgeNews reports that the Starlink university connectivity deal aligns with Sierra Leone's National Broadband Strategy for 2023-2028, a period that had not ended; the article gives no event date, so its published date of 2025-01-31 is used.

note: The Starlink/ELCOME SL university agreement is a single connectivity project (other), not a plan, and no money or progress figures are tied to the strategy, so no delivery fact.
